reason: Author manuscripts on PMC only. PMC served a reCAPTCHA page to scripts
consequence: and to our browser for the one article tried there (PMC3453753); Europe PMC has no XML for them and its PDF endpoint refuses scripts. Not bypassed.

item: 25-hydroxyvitamin D
reason: Cavalier 2021 (EuBIVAS; read in full) found no steady state over spring and states BV-based models are inappropriate for 25(OH)D. Trimmed CVIs (6.2-6.6% within 5-week windows; 6.3% over 10 weeks after removing 51.8% of results) are in bv_estimates.csv with include = no.
consequence: No vitamin D entry in the web file. An RCV built from these CVIs would ignore seasonal drift (about 2.8% per week in spring).

item: D-dimer
reason: EuBIVAS (Aarsand 2021, read) says the data are so heterogeneous that a mean CVI should not be used for RCVs; the coagulation meta-analysis (Hollestelle 2023, read; CVI 25.2%, CI 17.4-56.4) repeats that an average CVI does not represent the population. Healthy concentrations are near the detection limit.
consequence: Rows in bv_estimates.csv with include = no; no web entry.

item: Urine albumin and albumin/creatinine ratio
reason: The urine meta-analysis (read) found no BIVAC-eligible studies and gives only ranges (ACR 29-31% in first-morning urine from 2 papers) without the per-study estimates. Studies in CKD or diabetes are not healthy-population estimates.
consequence: No urine-acr, urine-albumin or urine-microalbumin entry.
